notes:
Background: Northbridge builds a product discovery layer used by B2B SaaS apps (search + recommendations). Recently saw regression in click-through after reindex; product team wants a modular reranker to sit as a second-stage endpoint. Currently evaluating Redwood Hosted API for fast iteration, then Dedicated for predictable throughput and lower unit cost.

Call highlights (10/22 Discovery, 11/05 Deep-dive):
- 10/22: Intro call w/ AE (Maya) + SE (Diego). Customer described current stack: Elasticsearch for recall, homegrown gradient-boosted reranker for final sort. Wants to replace reranker with an LLM-based reranker that uses embeddings + context signals.
- 11/05: Demo of hosted rerank endpoint (small sample). Ran 10k offline queries through Redwood hosted API to validate rerank quality vs baseline — initial NDCG uplift ~7-9% on internal eval set. Team pleased with qualitative relevance but wants deterministic latency & cost estimates.
- Customer quote: "We need predictable tail latency during peak ingest and a safe rollback path if quality drifts."

POC ask (from product lead):
- Scope: 1) Hosted POC for evaluation metrics (NDCG, MRR) on 50k labeled queries; 2) If hosted results acceptable, run a 2-week Dedicated POC simulating 200 qps peak with burst to 400 qps nightly; 3) Offline scoring job support: nightly batch scoring of 10M candidates.
- Success metrics: +5-10% NDCG over baseline OR improved CTR in A/B; P95 <=150ms for online rerank calls; nightly batch completes within 3 hours on Dedicated.

Pricing / commercial notes:
- Team asked for hosted pricing simulation vs Dedicated reserved capacity. Finance prefers a committed monthly price for Dedicated if unit economics are favorable. Forecast ARR discussion contingent on Dedicated pricing in $5k-$10k / month band.

Security / compliance:
- Requires SSO (SAML) + SOC2 attestation. Data residency: must ensure EU customer data stays in eu-west region for a subset of customers. Legal asked for standard Redwood DPA and subprocessor list.

Risks observed:
- Dedicated SLA clarity needed around model fallback when capacity is saturated. Product team worried about silent regressions during model rollout. Wants rollback/AB test features.
- Offline scoring throughput is large; need clear guidance on cost vs scheduling frequency.

Internal notes for AE/SE:
- Diego to prepare concrete latency profile for Dedicated under 200 qps and cost estimate for nightly 10M scoring job.
- Maya to follow up with pricing deck and template SOW.
- Suggested next meeting: 11/20 pricing + legal champions call (Sophie to join).
